editorial.blurb: Los Milagros brings creative, high-quality Mexican cooking to Revival Food Hall, where tender braised meats and fresh guacamole elevate every bite.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Beef Brisket Barbacoa Taco Bowl and customize it at the salsa bar with onions and cilantro—the portions are perfectly sized despite initial appearances, and the quality justifies the price.
